City id fukuoka. Display Fukuoka. Agency Fukuoka City Transportation Bureau (福岡市交通局). Not Tokyo Metro, not Osaka Metro. Do not invent city=fuk, fukuoka-metro, fukuoka-city, or merge into another Japanese city.

City stays planned. Modes v1: Fukuoka City Subway only — three official lines: Kūkō (Airport Line, K01-K13, orange), Hakozaki (H01-H07, blue), Nanakuma (N01-N18, green, includes the 27 March 2023 Hakata extension N17-N18). 36 unique station names, 38 line ticks (13+7+18) across the three lines.

No official public GTFS or GTFS-RT. Transitland: no Onestop ID. Mobility Database feeds_v2.csv: 0 rows for Fukuoka City Subway (checked 2026-09-06). ODPT membership list (checked 2026-09-02) does not include Fukuoka City Transportation Bureau. A community GTFS exists on GitHub (kuwayamamasayuki/GTFS-FukuokaCitySubway) but is NOT an official feed and was not used as a D1 source. Do not invent an ODPT zip because Tokyo Metro / Osaka Metro have one. No env key. adapterReady false.

Locked inner-city hub: Hakata (K11 x N18), the Kuko-Nanakuma metro interchange. doNotGroup vs JR Hakata (separate mainline/Shinkansen facility, not subway). Nakasu-Kawabata (K09 x H01) is the Kuko-Hakozaki interchange, not a three-line hub. Tenjin (K08, Kuko only) and Tenjin-Minami (N16, Nanakuma only) are distinct metro stations on opposite sides of Tenjin Chikagai underground mall; doNotGroup against each other and against Nishitetsu Fukuoka (Tenjin), a different private-rail network.

Through-run OUT of the line-graph v1 but IN at board eligibility: JR Chikuhi Line operates mutual through-service onto the Kuko line at Meinohama (K01). Riders board the walk-up, no-reservation JR through-train at the in-catalog K01 platform (verdict `in`, board eligibility rule). Chikuhi-only stations west of Meinohama (Chikuzen-Maebaru, Karatsu, Nishi-Karatsu, etc.) have no K-codes and are out of v1 scope entirely — not metro facilities.
36 unique official EN stop strings. 38 line ticks (K 13 + H 7 + N 18). Interchanges counted once in unique names: Nakasu-Kawabata (K09/H01), Hakata (K11/N18).
No stopIds in this file. No GTFS route ids. Passenger line tokens are the official letters K / H / N plus the official EN line names (Kuko, Hakozaki, Nanakuma).
